en: This game cannot be played by hand: §0§

zh: 过了第一个没定的回合，裁判面前的局面就不是真的了：不再抄
en: past the first undecided round the referee is no longer looking at the real position: stop copying

zh: 之后的回合按"什么都不做"走完，结果不算数
en: the remaining rounds are played out as "do nothing"; their results do not count

zh: 这一局推进不下去：裁判一直在问同一个回合。
en: This episode cannot advance: the referee keeps asking about the same round.
